## DevCtl
Scaffold only — no capability implemented yet.

First planned capability: observe/control the user's browser by reusing the CDP endpoint already exposed by the `aw-app-browser` container (in-workspace `aw-app-browser:9223`) — live screenshot + navigation.

Stub endpoint: `GET /api/apps/devctl/browser/screenshot` (returns 501 for now). See the repo README.
